matter: A petition against deletions in Maharashtra's revision, W.P.(C) No. 1330 of 2026. The Court issued notice to the Election Commission on 26 October.
due: The petition is listed for hearing. On 26 October the Court declined to extend the time for claims and objections or to stop the final roll before hearing the Commission.
quote: A Bench of Chief Justice of India Surya Kant , Justice Joymalya Bagchi and Justice V. Mohana heard Writ Petition (Civil) No. 1330 of 2026 on October 26, 2026, and listed it for November 5, 2026.

matter: The petitions alleging that decisions of the Election Commission, those on the revision among them, were taken without the agreement of the two Election Commissioners, led by W.P.(C) No. 1246 of 2026.
due: On 27 October the petitioners were given 10 days to file a rejoinder to the Commission's counter affidavit. The bench listed the matter for this date tentatively.
quote: Adjourning the hearing, the bench tentatively listed the matter on November 17.

matter: The petition of two transparency activists on Delhi's revision, W.P.(C) No. 1188 of 2026, and an application they were told to file on the Commission's letter about Form 6.
due: The matter is listed for hearing. On 4 November the Court declined to pass urgent orders and asked the petitioners to file their application before this date.
quote: The matter is already listed on November 19. We will hear it that day.

matter: A petition by a group of advocates for guidelines on processions and protests near the Supreme Court, after the Opposition's march of 12 October against the Chief Election Commissioner.
due: On 3 November the Court sought replies from Mallikarjun Kharge, Rahul Gandhi and the Centre, and the Centre said it would reply by this date.
quote: Posting the matter for November 23, a bench headed by Chief Justice of India (CJI) Surya Kant also sought the Centre’s response to the petition

matter: Petitions on Kerala's revision, heard with the matters on Uttar Pradesh and Chhattisgarh.
due: On 30 October the Election Commission was given four weeks to file its counter affidavit and to answer the points in the petitioners' note.
quote: सुप्रीम कोर्ट ने चुनाव आयोग को जवाबी हलफनामा दाखिल करने के लिए चार सप्ताह का समय दिया है।

matter: Petitions against the exclusion of electors in Maharashtra's revision. The Election Commission asked for them to be deferred because the Supreme Court is hearing the revision.
due: The petitions are listed for hearing. The High Court has given no view on their merits.
quote: The Bombay High Court has fixed December 1 for hearing petitions that challenge alleged arbitrary exclusions of voters during the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls in Maharashtra, after the Election Commission of India (ECI) sought a deferral

court: Court of the First Additional Sessions Judge
matter: A revision petition by the Banbhoolpura police against a Haldwani magistrate's order of 6 October to register an FIR over Form 7s filed to delete 28 electors in the name of a booth level agent who says he did not file them. On 30 October the court refused to stay the order.
due: The revision petition is listed for hearing.
quote: स्थगन अर्जी खारिज करने के साथ पुनरीक्षण याचिका पर अगली सुनवाई के लिए सात दिसंबर 2026 की तारीख तय की गई है।

matter: Petitions by the RJD Member of Parliament Manoj Jha and an advocate challenging section 16 of the Act of 2023 on the Chief Election Commissioner and the Election Commissioners, which bars civil and criminal proceedings against them for their official acts. The Court issued notice to the Centre and the Election Commission on 4 November.
due: The petitions are listed for hearing.
quote: The court listed the petitions on December 18.
